unit: one fictional convenience volunteer with one seven-day binary self-report
target: theta_desk minus theta_poster, route-specific reporting probabilities under a comparable regime
likelihood: independent Bernoulli records within and across the two routes, with one constant probability per route
primary_prior: independent Beta(1,1) for each route probability
sensitivity_prior: independent Beta(2,2) for each route probability, specified as a comparison rather than chosen after results
summary: posterior means, equal-tail 95 percent interval for difference, P(difference > 0), P(difference > 0.10)
checks: prior probability of zero in twelve poster records; posterior probability of zero in another comparable twelve
design_limit: nonrandom convenience recruitment; route contrast is associational, not an effect or a campus rate
computation: exact beta updates and deterministic integration; no MCMC
